name: isohue
source: wl-style's 02-color/isohue_spectrum/ (the PI's local work, not committed in wl-style on 2026-11-07): a CAM16-UCS hue sector at chroma 29.49, matched in macaque cone luminance (L + M at L:M 1, Stockman-Sharpe 2-degree fundamentals, colour-science 0.4.7's 1 nm table). Blue (hue 260), purple (320) and red (20): its isohue_levels.csv, mode cone_macaque_equal, saturation 1.00; the apex: its gray, #969696. Green (140): computed with its generator, isohue.py, at the same chroma and luminance under colour-science 0.4.7 on 2026-11-07. Copied from wl-xcon's tests/fixtures/isohue.json. The rig (wl-xcon) holds them equal on the CIE's own 2006 2-degree cone fundamentals (DOI 10.25039/CIE.DS.tijidesg, CIE 170-1:2006 table 6.7), the same fundamentals tabulated at 5 nm.
